title: lobelia racemosa subsp. ryanii
intro: Lobelia racemosa subsp. ryanii, commonly known as Rydberg's Lobelia, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the bellflower family. It is native to North America and is often used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which may help to relieve pain and reduce inflammation, and is also believed to have therapeutic actions such as relaxing muscles and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Rydberg's Lobelia include alkaloids like lobeline and lobelanine, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
